name: Oral Expression
definition: The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.

benchmark.name: Blizzard Challenge
benchmark.metric: Mean opinion score for naturalness on a 1–5 scale, averaged over all listeners
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce speaking read or prepared text aloud in work settings. The directly measured anchor is the professional recorded speaker whose natural speech set the benchmark ceiling.

benchmark.name: Blizzard Challenge 2023
benchmark.metric: MOS, 1-5 scale (listeners rated quality/naturalness on the Hub task FH1)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who read prepared text aloud in work settings (announcements, presentations, reading scripts), in French

benchmark.name: Big Bench Audio
benchmark.human_reference: General adult working population communicating orally at work, answering spoken logic and reasoning questions aloud without writing aids

benchmark.name: VocalBench
benchmark.metric: VocalBench overall composite score (0-100 scale, aggregated across semantic, acoustic, chat and robustness sub-metrics)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who communicate orally at work: typical employees answering questions, explaining information and following spoken requests in conversation.

benchmark.name: VocalBench
benchmark.metric: VocalBench overall composite score (0-100 scale, aggregated across semantic, acoustic, chat and robustness sub-metrics)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce who communicate orally at work: typical employees answering questions, explaining information and following spoken requests in conversation.
